title: HyperGen: Artifact for "Empowering Ultra-high-resolution Video Generation Framework with Sketch-Tile Collaboration" (PPoPP 2027)
description: Artifact of the PPoPP 2027 paper HyperGen: the implementation (two-stage tiled generation, region-aware cache, cache-guided tile parallelism) for CogVideoX-1.5, HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1; runners for every experiment in the paper's evaluation (Tables 3-5, Figures 11-14); the VBench and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS scoring pipeline; the raw measurements behind the paper's tables and figures; and the scripts that regenerate the tables and figures.
